verdict.rationale: Swell offers general-purpose extension points that can be applied to checkout. Data models can add fields to existing models such as orders. Serverless functions and webhooks let you inject custom logic. Liquid themes and any-framework frontends cover branding, and price rules handle discounts. None of the evidence documents checkout-specific extension points, so applying these to checkout is inferred rather than shown. Missing for 10: documented checkout-specific hooks for custom fields and validation, checkout branding/UI customization docs, discount extension APIs at checkout, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
